## 値

### map

```emela
fn map[A, B](opt: Option[A], f: fn(A) -> B fails E(f) uses { R(f) }) -> Option[B] fails E(f) uses { R(f) }
```

Applies `f` to the contents of a `Some`. `None` stays `None`.

### and_then

```emela
fn and_then[A, B](opt: Option[A], f: fn(A) -> Option[B] fails E(f) uses { R(f) }) -> Option[B] fails E(f) uses { R(f) }
```

Applies `f`, which returns an Option, to the contents of a `Some` and flattens the
result. `None` stays `None`.

### or

```emela
fn or[A](opt: Option[A], default: A) -> A
```

The value, or `default` if `None`.

### is_some

```emela
fn is_some[A](opt: Option[A]) -> Bool
```

Whether it is `Some`.

### is_none

```emela
fn is_none[A](opt: Option[A]) -> Bool
```

Whether it is `None`.

### or_fail

```emela
fn or_fail[A, E](opt: Option[A], err: E) -> A fails E
```

Fails with `err` if `None` (`[error.fail]`). Turns an Option into a failure, as in
`users.find(id).or_fail(NotFound(id:))`.
